bio:
[Owner Name], CPL, has spent [X]+ years working the full spectrum of land services — from courthouse-level abstracting in East Texas and Louisiana to complex mineral and royalty management across multiple basins. A Certified Professional Landman (CPL) credentialed by the American Association of Professional Landmen (AAPL), [he/she/they] brings both technical depth and practical judgment to every engagement.

[He/She/They] began [his/her/their] career in [area/region] and has since built a practice spanning title examination, lease acquisition, A&D due diligence, right-of-way work, and solar and wind land acquisition. Working with independent operators, major producers, and institutional investors, [Owner Name] is known for delivering thorough, defensible work on time — whether the project is a single-tract curative issue or a multi-county acquisition package.

Based in [Location], [he/she/they] serves clients across the Gulf Coast, Appalachian Basin, and beyond.
approach:
The land business rewards thoroughness. Title defects discovered after closing, rights overlooked during acquisition, agreements that don't survive scrutiny — these are the problems that experienced landmen are hired to prevent.

My approach is straightforward: understand the project objective, do the work carefully, and communicate clearly. You'll know exactly what I've found, what it means, and what your options are. No surprises, no hedged reports, no work that won't hold up to a second look.

I work directly with clients — not through layers of staff — so the person you call is the person doing the work.
